errors.text: The proposed carbon-alloying intervention does not reconstruct the target intervention of orientation-dependent uniaxial tensile loading of single-crystal FCC FeNiCrMn.
The asserted carbide formation, grain refinement, and simultaneous strength–ductility improvement are unsupported by cited evidence or a specified carbon concentration and processing route.
The temperature and strain-rate bounds are arbitrary and disagree with the target simulation regime of 10–600 K and 10^8–10^10 s^-1.
The mechanism omits the target vacancy-assisted nucleation of Shockley partial dislocations, stacking-fault formation, anisotropy, and temperature/rate effects.
The hypothesis does not identify the target outcomes: maximum yield stress along <-111>, temperature-induced yield softening, rate-insensitive yield strength, and rate-dependent dislocation density.
